17.title: CMDB Apps By Tier

18.title: Application Observability Overview
18.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| fields
    app_key = cmdb_ci_key,
    `Application` = name,
    AppShortName = short_name,
    owner = owned_by,
    `Business Unit` = dv_business_unit,
    tier = business_criticality,
    Status = dv_operational_status,
    application_type = application_type,
    rum_expected_raw = rum_expected,
    rum_domains = rum_domains
| fieldsAdd
  app_short_name_lower = lower(AppShortName),
  rum_expected_num = toLong(coalesce(rum_expected_raw, 0))
| lookup [
    load "/lookups/cmdb_server"
    | fields app_key = busapp_cmdb_ci_key, server_name = lower(name), server_location = location
    | lookup [
        fetch dt.entity.host
        | fields id, entity.name, monitoringMode, paasVendorType, isMonitoringCandidate
        | fieldsAdd monitoringMode = if(isNotNull(paasVendorType), then:"APP_ONLY", else:if(isMonitoringCandidate == true, then:"CANDIDATE", else:monitoringMode))
        | parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
        | fieldsAdd server_name = lower(hostname)
        | lookup [
            fetch logs
            | summarize logCount = count(), by:{host_id = dt.entity.host}
          ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{logCount}
        | lookup [
            fetch spans
            | summarize spanCount = count(), by:{host_id = dt.entity.host}
          ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{spanCount}
        | lookup [
            timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), by:{host_id = dt.entity.host}
            | fieldsAdd metricEvidence = if(arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(cpu)) > 0, then:1, else:0)
            | fields host_id, metricEvidence
          ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{metricEvidence}
        | summarize
            dt_matched = max(if(isNotNull(id), then:1, else:0)),
            full_stack = max(if(monitoringMode == "FULL_STACK", then:1, else:0)),
            infrastructure = max(if(monitoringMode == "INFRASTRUCTURE", then:1, else:0)),
            app_only = max(if(monitoringMode == "APP_ONLY", then:1, else:0)),
            discovery = max(if(monitoringMode == "DISCOVERY", then:1, else:0)),
            metric_covered = max(coalesce(metricEvidence, 0)),
            log_covered = max(if(isNotNull(logCount) AND logCount > 0, then:1, else:0)),
            trace_covered = max(if(isNotNull(spanCount) AND spanCount > 0, then:1, else:0)),
            by:{server_name}
      ], sourceField:server_name, lookupField:server_name, fields:{dt_matched, full_stack, infrastructure, app_only, discovery, metric_covered, log_covered, trace_covered}
    | summarize
        location = takeFirst(server_location),
        locationCount = countDistinct(server_location),
        locationList = collectDistinct(server_location),
        `CMDB Servers` = count(),
        FootprintRaw = sum(coalesce(dt_matched, 0)),
        fullStackCount = sum(coalesce(full_stack, 0)),
        infraCount = sum(coalesce(infrastructure, 0)),
        appOnlyCount = sum(coalesce(app_only, 0)),
        discoveryCount = sum(coalesce(discovery, 0)),
        metricCoveredServers = sum(coalesce(metric_covered, 0)),
        logCoveredServers = sum(coalesce(log_covered, 0)),
        traceCoveredServers = sum(coalesce(trace_covered, 0)),
        by:{app_key}
  ], sourceField:app_key, lookupField:app_key, fields:{location, locationCount, locationList, `CMDB Servers`, FootprintRaw, fullStackCount, infraCount, appOnlyCount, discoveryCount, metricCoveredServers, logCoveredServers, traceCoveredServers}
| lookup [
    fetch dt.davis.problems
    | filter not(dt.davis.is_duplicate) AND event.status == "ACTIVE"
    | expand affected_entity_id = affected_entity_ids
    | filter matchesPhrase(affected_entity_id, "HOST-")
    | lookup [
        fetch dt.entity.host
        | fields id, tags
        | expand tag = tags
        | parse tag, """'HGApp:' LD:appShortName EOS"""
        | filter isNotNull(appShortName)
        | fieldsAdd appShortName = lower(appShortName)
        | fields id, appShortName
      ], sourceField:affected_entity_id, lookupField:id, fields:{appShortName}
    | filter isNotNull(appShortName)
    | summarize activeProblems = countDistinct(display_id), by:{appShortName}
  ], sourceField:app_short_name_lower, lookupField:appShortName, fields:{activeProblems}
| lookup [
    load "/lookups/cmdb_app_frontend_mapping"
    | fields
        app_key = app_cmdb_ci_key,
        frontend_entity_id,
        user_event_count_24h,
        session_count_24h,
        last_seen_user_event,
        mapping_confidence,
        mapping_method,
        frontend_name
    | fieldsAdd
        user_event_count_24h = toLong(coalesce(user_event_count_24h, 0)),
        session_count_24h = toLong(coalesce(session_count_24h, 0))
    | summarize
        mappedFrontendCount = countDistinct(frontend_entity_id),
        rumUserEvents24h = sum(user_event_count_24h),
        rumSessions24h = sum(session_count_24h),
        rumLastSeen = max(last_seen_user_event),
        rumMappingConfidence = takeFirst(mapping_confidence),
        rumMappingMethod = takeFirst(mapping_method),
        rumFrontendName = takeFirst(frontend_name),
        by:{app_key}
  ], sourceField:app_key, lookupField:app_key, fields:{mappedFrontendCount, rumUserEvents24h, rumSessions24h, rumLastSeen, rumMappingConfidence, rumMappingMethod, rumFrontendName}
| fieldsAdd
    `CMDB Servers` = coalesce(`CMDB Servers`, 0),
    FootprintRaw = coalesce(FootprintRaw, 0),
    locationCount = coalesce(locationCount, 0),
    locationList = coalesce(locationList, array()),
    fullStackCount = coalesce(fullStackCount, 0),
    infraCount = coalesce(infraCount, 0),
    appOnlyCount = coalesce(appOnlyCount, 0),
    discoveryCount = coalesce(discoveryCount, 0),
    metricCoveredServers = coalesce(metricCoveredServers, 0),
    logCoveredServers = coalesce(logCoveredServers, 0),
    traceCoveredServers = coalesce(traceCoveredServers, 0),
    `Active Problems` = coalesce(activeProblems, 0),
    mappedFrontendCount = coalesce(mappedFrontendCount, 0),
    rumUserEvents24h = coalesce(rumUserEvents24h, 0),
    rumSessions24h = coalesce(rumSessions24h, 0),
    rumMappingConfidence = coalesce(rumMappingConfidence, "none"),
    rumMappingMethod = coalesce(rumMappingMethod, "none"),
    rumFrontendName = coalesce(rumFrontendName, "")
| fieldsAdd
    `CMDB Servers` = toLong(`CMDB Servers`),
    FootprintRaw = toLong(FootprintRaw),
    locationCount = toLong(locationCount),
    fullStackCount = toLong(fullStackCount),
    infraCount = toLong(infraCount),
    appOnlyCount = toLong(appOnlyCount),
    discoveryCount = toLong(discoveryCount),
    metricCoveredServers = toLong(metricCoveredServers),
    logCoveredServers = toLong(logCoveredServers),
    traceCoveredServers = toLong(traceCoveredServers),
    `Active Problems` = toLong(`Active Problems`)
| fieldsAdd
  `Coverage Gap` = `CMDB Servers` - FootprintRaw,
  `Coverage %` = if(`CMDB Servers` == 0, then:0.0, else:round(100.0 * FootprintRaw / `CMDB Servers`, decimals:1)),
  monitoringMode = if(FootprintRaw == 0, then:"None", else:if(fullStackCount == FootprintRaw AND infraCount == 0 AND appOnlyCount == 0 AND discoveryCount == 0, then:"Full Stack Only", else:if(infraCount == FootprintRaw AND fullStackCount == 0 AND appOnlyCount == 0 AND discoveryCount == 0, then:"Infrastructure Only", else:if(appOnlyCount == FootprintRaw AND fullStackCount == 0 AND infraCount == 0 AND discoveryCount == 0, then:"App Only", else:if(discoveryCount == FootprintRaw, then:"Discovery Only", else:"Mixed"))))),
  `Trace Evidence` = concat(toString(traceCoveredServers), "/", toString(`CMDB Servers`)),
  `Metric Evidence` = concat(toString(metricCoveredServers), "/", toString(`CMDB Servers`)),
  `Log Evidence` = concat(toString(logCoveredServers), "/", toString(`CMDB Servers`)),
  `Location Scope` = if(locationCount == 0, then:"Unknown", else:if(locationCount == 1, then:arrayToString(arraySort(locationList), delimiter:", "), else:concat(toString(locationCount), " locations: ", arrayToString(arraySort(locationList), delimiter:", ")))),
  RUM = if(rum_expected_num == 0, then:"N/A", else:if(mappedFrontendCount == 0, then:"Missing", else:if(rumUserEvents24h > 0, then:"Active", else:"Configured but inactive"))),
  `RUM Evidence` = concat(toString(rumUserEvents24h), " events / ", toString(rumSessions24h), " sessions"),
  `RUM Mapping` = if(mappedFrontendCount == 0, then:"none", else:concat(rumMappingMethod, " (", rumMappingConfidence, ")"))
| fieldsAdd
  `Mode Mix` = concat("FS ", toString(fullStackCount), " | Infra ", toString(infraCount), " | App ", toString(appOnlyCount), " | Disc ", toString(discoveryCount), " | Missing ", toString(`Coverage Gap`))
| fieldsAdd
    `Coverage Status` = if(`Coverage Gap` == 0, then:"Complete", else:if(FootprintRaw == 0, then:"Missing", else:"Partial")),
    Footprint = if(`Coverage Gap` > 0, then:concat("! ", toString(FootprintRaw)), else:toString(FootprintRaw)),
    Traces = if(traceCoveredServers == 0, then:"❌", else:if(traceCoveredServers == `CMDB Servers`, then:"✅", else:"⚠️")),
    Metrics = if(metricCoveredServers == 0, then:"❌", else:if(metricCoveredServers == `CMDB Servers`, then:"✅", else:"⚠️")),
    Logs = if(logCoveredServers == 0, then:"❌", else:if(logCoveredServers == `CMDB Servers`, then:"✅", else:"⚠️")),
    `Observability Quality` = if(FootprintRaw == 0, then:"Missing", else:if(`Coverage Gap` > 0, then:"Partial Coverage", else:if(traceCoveredServers < `CMDB Servers` OR metricCoveredServers < `CMDB Servers` OR logCoveredServers < `CMDB Servers`, then:"Weak Signals", else:"Complete")))
| filter in(`Application`, array($ApplicationName))
| filter in(`Business Unit`, array($BusinessUnit))
| filter in(tier, array($Tier))
| filter in(location, array($Location))
| filter in(monitoringMode, array($MonitoringMode))
| filter in(Status, array($Status))
| fields `Application`, `Business Unit`, AppShortName, owner, tier, application_type, rum_domains, `Location Scope`, `Mode Mix`, monitoringMode, Traces, `Trace Evidence`, Metrics, `Metric Evidence`, Logs, `Log Evidence`, RUM, `RUM Evidence`, `RUM Mapping`, `Active Problems`, Footprint, `CMDB Servers`, `Coverage Gap`, `Coverage %`, `Observability Quality`, `Coverage Status`, Status
| sort `Coverage Gap` desc, `Application` asc

19.title: Servers Monitored by Dynatrace
19.query:
fetch dt.entity.host
| fieldsAdd host_name = entity.name
| fields id, entity.name,  monitoringMode, paasVendorType, isMonitoringCandidate, awsNameTag
| fieldsAdd monitoringMode = if(isNotNull(paasVendorType), "APP_ONLY", else:if(isMonitoringCandidate == true, "CANDIDATE", else:monitoringMode))
| parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
| lookup [ load "/lookups/cmdb_server"], sourcefield:hostname, lookupfield:name, fields:{server_fqdn = fully_qualified_domain_name, cmdb_ci_key}
| fieldsRemove paasVendorType, awsNameTag, isMonitoringCandidate
| fieldsAdd isInCMDB = if(isNull(cmdb_ci_key), "NOT FOUND IN CMDB", else:"FOUND IN CMDB")
| filterOut isInCMDB == "NOT FOUND IN CMDB" 
| filterOut monitoringMode == "CANDIDATE"
| limit 20000
| summarize `Monitored Servers` = count()

20.title: Applications Not in Dynatrace

21.title: Application Server Coverage Drilldown
21.query:
load "/lookups/cmdb_businessapp"
| fields app_key = cmdb_ci_key, `Application` = name, `Business Unit` = dv_business_unit, tier = business_criticality, Status = dv_operational_status
| lookup [
    load "/lookups/cmdb_server"
    | fields app_key = busapp_cmdb_ci_key, `Server` = name, Location = location
    | fieldsAdd server_name = lower(`Server`)
    | lookup [
        fetch dt.entity.host
        | fields id, entity.name, monitoringMode, paasVendorType, isMonitoringCandidate
        | fieldsAdd monitoringMode = if(isNotNull(paasVendorType), then:"APP_ONLY", else:if(isMonitoringCandidate == true, then:"CANDIDATE", else:monitoringMode))
        | parse entity.name, """LD:hostname ('.' LD:domain)? EOS"""
        | fieldsAdd server_name = lower(hostname)
        | lookup [
            fetch logs
            | summarize logCount = count(), by:{host_id = dt.entity.host}
          ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{logCount}
        | lookup [
            fetch spans
            | summarize spanCount = count(), by:{host_id = dt.entity.host}
          ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{spanCount}
        | lookup [
            timeseries cpu = avg(dt.host.cpu.usage), by:{host_id = dt.entity.host}
            | fieldsAdd metricEvidence = if(arraySize(arrayRemoveNulls(cpu)) > 0, then:1, else:0)
            | fields host_id, metricEvidence
          ], sourceField:id, lookupField:host_id, fields:{metricEvidence}
        | summarize
            hostMatch = max(if(isNotNull(id), then:1, else:0)),
            fullStackCount = sum(if(monitoringMode == "FULL_STACK", then:1, else:0)),
            infraCount = sum(if(monitoringMode == "INFRASTRUCTURE", then:1, else:0)),
            appOnlyCount = sum(if(monitoringMode == "APP_ONLY", then:1, else:0)),
            discoveryCount = sum(if(monitoringMode == "DISCOVERY", then:1, else:0)),
            traceEvidence = max(if(isNotNull(spanCount) AND spanCount > 0, then:1, else:0)),
            metricEvidence = max(coalesce(metricEvidence, 0)),
            logEvidence = max(if(isNotNull(logCount) AND logCount > 0, then:1, else:0)),
            by:{server_name}
      ], sourceField:server_name, lookupField:server_name, fields:{hostMatch, fullStackCount, infraCount, appOnlyCount, discoveryCount, traceEvidence, metricEvidence, logEvidence}
  ], sourceField:app_key, lookupField:app_key, fields:{`Server`, Location, hostMatch, fullStackCount, infraCount, appOnlyCount, discoveryCount, traceEvidence, metricEvidence, logEvidence}
| fieldsAdd
    hostMatch = coalesce(hostMatch, 0),
    fullStackCount = coalesce(fullStackCount, 0),
    infraCount = coalesce(infraCount, 0),
    appOnlyCount = coalesce(appOnlyCount, 0),
    discoveryCount = coalesce(discoveryCount, 0),
    traceEvidence = coalesce(traceEvidence, 0),
    metricEvidence = coalesce(metricEvidence, 0),
    logEvidence = coalesce(logEvidence, 0)
| fieldsAdd
    `Dynatrace Match` = if(hostMatch > 0, then:"✅", else:"❌"),
    `Mode Detail` = if(hostMatch == 0, then:"Missing", else:if(fullStackCount > 0 AND infraCount == 0 AND appOnlyCount == 0 AND discoveryCount == 0, then:"Full Stack", else:if(infraCount > 0 AND fullStackCount == 0 AND appOnlyCount == 0 AND discoveryCount == 0, then:"Infrastructure", else:if(appOnlyCount > 0 AND fullStackCount == 0 AND infraCount == 0 AND discoveryCount == 0, then:"App Only", else:if(discoveryCount > 0 AND fullStackCount == 0 AND infraCount == 0 AND appOnlyCount == 0, then:"Discovery", else:"Mixed"))))),
    Traces = if(traceEvidence == 1, then:"✅", else:if(hostMatch == 1, then:"❌", else:"❌")),
    Metrics = if(metricEvidence == 1, then:"✅", else:if(hostMatch == 1, then:"❌", else:"❌")),
    Logs = if(logEvidence == 1, then:"✅", else:if(hostMatch == 1, then:"❌", else:"❌")),
    `Server Quality` = if(hostMatch == 0, then:"Missing", else:if(traceEvidence == 1 AND metricEvidence == 1 AND logEvidence == 1, then:"Complete", else:"Weak Signals"))
| fieldsAdd ServerQualityRank = if(`Server Quality` == "Missing", then:3, else:if(`Server Quality` == "Weak Signals", then:2, else:1))
| filter in(`Application`, array($ApplicationName))
| filter in(`Business Unit`, array($BusinessUnit))
| filter in(tier, array($Tier))
| filter in(Location, array($Location))
| filter in(Status, array($Status))
| sort ServerQualityRank desc, `Application` asc, `Server` asc
| fields `Application`, `Server`, Location, `Dynatrace Match`, `Mode Detail`, Traces, Metrics, Logs, `Server Quality`, `Business Unit`, tier, Status
